== Regarding the Memory of Light account of Bela's death vs. Companion account of living after the Last Battle ==

The way the Companion states it, Bela somehow "unaccountably survived." Maybe it's as simple as that, and she made it off the battlefield offstage, but I wonder if Bela might not have come back as a Hero of the Horn with Noal. A Memory of Light describes a "beautiful white horse" that Olver saw behind Noal after he blew the Horn of Valere. Perhaps that was her Hero form, reclaimed after her physical life was over. After all, the Wolves appeared as Heroes at Shayol Ghul. And all the Heroes lived multiple lives. She could then have been reborn after the Last Battle to a similar breed of horse and made her way back to the Two Rivers as a young mare to produce that colt and filly that the Companion mentioned. She still would have been Bela in that new life.
